title: Lab - Worker node failure
description: Bring a NotReady node back, three different ways.
scenario: Bring a NotReady node back, three different ways. This lab is a skeleton: the tasks name what to do and how to check it; work them on your own cluster and expand your notes as you go.
environment_setup:
# A three-node kind cluster is enough for this lab
cat <<'EOF' > kind-cka.yaml
kind: Cluster
apiVersion: kind.x-k8s.io/v1alpha4
name: cka
nodes:
  - role: control-plane
  - role: worker
  - role: worker
EOF
kind create cluster --config kind-cka.yaml
kubectl get nodes
cleanup:
kind delete cluster --name cka
rm -f kind-cka.yaml

tasks.title: Task 1 - Service down
tasks.instructions: node01 is NotReady. Check the kubelet and start it.
tasks.solution:
ssh node01 systemctl status kubelet
systemctl start kubelet

tasks.title: Task 2 - Wrong cert path
tasks.instructions: NotReady again. Read the kubelet logs and fix the CA path in its config.

tasks.title: Task 3 - Wrong port
tasks.instructions: The kubelet points at the wrong API server port in kubelet.conf. Fix it.
